name: Remove count badge from Board / Table view selector (KanbanBoardView.vue)
description: Objective: in src/components/kanban/board/KanbanBoardView.vue remove the numeric count badge from the "Board" and "Table" tabs of the toolbar view switcher. Steps: 1. In the `viewTabs` computed, delete the `count` property from the `board` and `table` entries in BOTH branches (sprint branch: `count: this.totalTasks` twice; kanban branch: `count: this.sidebarTasks.length` and `count: this.boardChats.length`). 2. Leave the `planning` / `followup` entries and `gantt` (`count: null`) untouched, and leave the template badge block `…` as it is. 3. Do not remove the `sidebarTasks` / `boardChats` / `totalTasks` computeds (used by the subtitle, sidebar and sprint stats). Acceptance: Board and Table buttons show only icon + label for kanban and sprint boards; Planning/Follow-up keep their badges; view switching still works; no ESLint errors; diff limited to that single file.

messages.content: Remove the count badge from the Board and Table tabs of the view switcher in src/components/kanban/board/KanbanBoardView.vue (viewTabs computed, both kanban and sprint branches). Keep everything else unchanged.
